name: THE RIVER
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE BAR
LOOK_AT: A gravel bar in the middle of the river, dry and flat: the bar.
The camp holds its Assay out there. A man has to wade to lose.
A ring of stones and a stump to stand on. It's a courtroom, if you squint.
LISTEN_TO: Water going round it on both sides.
The river arguing with the bar, as it always does.

subjects.name: THE LONG TOM
LOOK_AT: A long wooden trough with water running down it, and riffles to catch the gold.
Two men feed it gravel and a third guards it with a shovel.
There's color in the riffles. Real gold, in a box, in the open. I've never been so close.
LISTEN_TO: Water and gravel rattling down it.
A shovel scraping, and a man counting shovelfuls.
The rattle stops, and three men lean in, breathing.

overrides.PICK_UP: There's gold in it, in plain sight, and a man with a shovel in plainer sight.

subjects.name: THE ROCKER
LOOK_AT: A rocker: a box on curved feet, rocked like a cradle, full of mud.
A man in a good hat is rocking it, scowling, as if the gold had insulted him.
He's rocked it so long the feet have worn hollows in the bank.
LISTEN_TO: The man rocking it, swearing in time.

overrides.USE: I offered to rock it a while. He held on tighter, as if I'd asked to hold his wallet.

subjects.name: THE WATER
LOOK_AT: A cold, fast river, with rich men standing in it to the knee.
The water's brown with everybody's digging. Downstream it's somebody else's problem.
I put a hand in. I took it out again. They stand in this all day.
LISTEN_TO: Teeth chattering, out in the river.
The river, loud, not caring who's rich.

overrides.TALK_TO: I told the river it had made a lot of men rich. It went on past, not interested.

subjects.name: THE TENTS
LOOK_AT: Back up the bank to the tents.
Back to the tents, where it's dry and nobody trusts me any less.
Smoke from the cook fire, going straight up. Somebody's dinner, and nobody watching it.
LISTEN_TO: A bolt sliding home, up among the cabins.

subjects.name: UPSTREAM
LOOK_AT: The river bends up the gulch, toward the best ground.
There's a man up there on his own, shouting at a stake.
The gulch narrows up there. The ground gets better and the people get worse.
LISTEN_TO: Water coming down faster, from up the gulch.
A man upstream, shouting at nobody.
Falling water, faint, a long way up.

THE PANNER.PICK_UP: I'm not lifting a man out of the river. He'd climb straight back in. It's where the money is.
THE PANNER.PUSH: He's in the river to his knees. One push would finish the job, and ruin the coat.
THE PANNER.USE: I asked for a go with his pan. He turned his back on me and panned faster.
